pose_authorities.role: V17 pose/camera authorities with explicitly approved coherent staged replacements for affected locomotion directions

production_method: 4 separately generated identity anchors plus 148 separately generated gameplay masters; V17 supplies pose/camera authority only; V14 supplies gameplay raster processing; SE idle mirror and sit-down reverse are local derivations

front_arc.rule: exact V17 pose authority + immutable portrait + matching approved front, dimetric SW, or W-profile anchor

later_idle_and_all_walk.rule: same fixed references as the direction plus that direction's approved idle phase-00 key; never use the previous animation phase

rear.rule: exact V17 pose authority + approved back anchor only

seated_ne.rule: exact V17 pose authority + approved back and W-profile anchors + approved NE seated neutral and mirrored-NW standing endpoint; seated neutral bootstraps from pose, anchors, and standing endpoint

seated_se.rule: exact V17 pose authority + immutable portrait + approved dimetric SW anchor + approved SE seated neutral and mirrored-SW standing endpoint

wnw.rule: exact V17 pose authority + approved W-profile anchor + approved back anchor
